title: Scientific Gate C3 — fMRI Perception-to-Imagery Transfer and Reconstruction Readiness
primary_question: Does a perception-trained fMRI decoder recover visual-semantic information from mental imagery strongly and reproducibly enough to justify a later image-reconstruction experiment?
secondary_question: Can a low-capacity imagery-state calibration transform improve transfer on held-out imagery targets without changing the frozen perception decoder?

hypotheses.H1_perception_foundation: Ridge decoder on NSD perception predicts CLIP embeddings above shuffled null
hypotheses.H2_zero_shot_transfer: Frozen perception decoder on imagery fMRI predicts correct target above null
hypotheses.H4_state_transport: Low-capacity transport improves imagery MRR above identity

prior_expectation.justification: Kneeland et al. 2025 and Spera et al. 2026 both show frozen zero-shot at chance

decision_rules.PASS_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED: H1 pass AND H2 null AND H4 pass
decision_rules.BLOCKED: H1 pass AND H2 null AND H4 null/inconclusive
